retrieval.title: Retrieval
retrieval.question_set: eval/questions/*.json — 40 questions, 20 per repository, fixed into two splits before any run
retrieval.scored: The retrieval step of the chat: embed the question, take the nearest records, rerank them by keyword overlap. A record counts as relevant when its file is one of the question's expected files.

providers.note: The server's default. A hashed bag of words over identifier subtokens, not a semantic embedding.

structural.title: Structural analysis against Python's ast
structural.note: Python only. `ast` is a different parser by a different author, so the two agree or they do not. Precision of 1.000 is partly structural: the graph only claims a target it resolved through imports and scope, and pays for that quiet in recall.

disagreements.subject: get_signature
disagreements.note: dispatched through self on a base class

structural.disagreements_note: All of them are misses: no disagreement has the graph claiming a call that `ast` did not find. Two of the four are `ast` over-counting, because it matches a call by its trailing name and is not type-aware.

limitations.title: Limitations and weak checks

smoke_check.title: Answer smoke check
smoke_check.what_it_is: Two string tests per answer: is the expected file among the citations, and does the answer contain one short hand-written word. There is no judge model and nothing reads whether the explanation is correct, complete or well reasoned. A wrong answer can pass; a good one fails on a synonym.

recorded.results_entry: Check: deep-mode answer smoke test rerun, with the quota damage removed
Check: deep-mode smoke test after the mentor-first fix — **the score did not improve**

smoke_check.note: The last complete pass of each mode. A third deep pass reached only 8 of the 15 questions before the provider's daily limit stopped it, and is not comparable with either. Deep mode is worse than fast mode on this check and the reason is not settled.

sample_sizes.detail: 20 per repository, 10 development and 10 held out each
24 itsdangerous and 25 flask, 26 development / 23 held out
run in each of the two chat modes

limitations.sample_size_note: On a split of 20 questions one question is 0.05 of a hit rate, so a difference of two or three questions is not a result. The subjects were chosen by hand, which is a bias a held-out split narrows but does not remove.
limitations.repos_note: Two Python libraries by the same authors. Nothing here says how the system behaves on another language, a larger repository, or code written in a different style.

recorded.results_entry: Check: what a full 1,705-document flask index would cost, with the cap left at 600

document_cap.note: A capped index keeps the first 600 documents in collection order - every file record, then functions - which is not a random sample. Every retrieval figure above was measured on the uncapped corpus; what a capped index would score has not been measured.
